scripts.title: OP
scripts.features:
Features >

> INF WINS
> INF ROCKS
> INF BOOSTFRIEND
> OPEN SOURCER
scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(Game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bloodball/-back-ups-for-libs/main/wizard"))()
local Window = Library:NewWindow("Script")
 
local Tab = Window:NewSection("Credits: TGMANKASKE")
 
Tab:CreateButton("Skip all daily", function()
print("HI")

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("SetDaily"):FireServer()

end)

Tab:CreateButton("Inf. Friend Boost", function()
print("HI")

local args = {
	99999999999,
	"9b831fa0-3afb-420b-9435-e4bdc38fe517"
}
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("ReceiveFriendBoost"):FireServer(unpack(args))


end)

Tab:CreateToggle("Inf. Wins", function(no)
_G.GetWins = no
while _G.GetWins== true do
    wait()  

local args = {
	-999999999999
}
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("SubtractWins"):FireServer(unpack(args))

end
end)


Tab:CreateToggle("Inf. Rocks", function(no)
_G.GetWins = no
while _G.GetWins== true do
    wait()  


local args = {
	99999999999,
	"9b831fa0-3afb-420b-9435-e4bdc38fe517",
	true
}
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("GiveRolls"):FireServer(unpack(args))

end
end)

local Tab = Window:NewSection("Links")
 
Tab:CreateButton("Discord Group", function()
print("HI")
 
setclipboard("https://discord.gg/8A6k73JqCM")
toclipboard("https://discord.gg/8A6k73JqCM")
 
end)
 
Tab:CreateButton("Youtube", function()
print("HI")
 
setclipboard("https://www.youtube.com/@TGMANKASKE")
toclipboard("https://www.youtube.com/@TGMANKASKE")
 
end)
